AC amendment (gap-analysis, ac_verify_defect — anti-vacuous-green): (1) an out-of-scope case MUST be recorded as skipped-with-reason and NOT counted as a pass in the equivalence tally; (2) a manifest/corpus case referencing a corpus entry absent from corpus-index.yaml MUST fail loud (non-zero), not silently skip; (3) if DSO_CORPUS_INDEX or DSO_RUNNER_MANIFEST is missing/unreadable, exit non-zero BEFORE running any case (fail-fast, path named); (4) the suite MUST fail loud if ZERO cases were executed (guards the false-green where a misconfigured path/all-out-of-scope yields a vacuous pass).
  Verify: bash -c 'DSO_CORPUS_INDEX=/nonexistent/nope.yaml bash tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]' AND grep -Eqi 'no cases|zero cases|executed 0|count.*0' tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence.sh
